intro: Draft's done. 160 picks, 16 rounds, 24 hours a pick, one full reset because Nick can't work a phone, and somehow Nicky still drafted two kickers.
Here's where everyone sits before a single snap. Grades are from the draft, rank is Tony's opinion, argue in the chat.

quickHits.label: The Watson incident
quickHits.text: Nfatboy accidentally drafted Christian Watson at pick 103. The ENTIRE draft got paused and reset so he could take DK Metcalf instead. Then J Will took Christian Watson three picks later. On purpose. One of these is worse and it's not the accident.

quickHits.label: Puka watch
quickHits.text: Nokia Wolson's WR1 spent the offseason getting sued for allegedly biting a woman on the shoulder on New Year's Eve, hard enough to leave a full set of teeth marks. His lawyer called it 'horseplay.' Then he went to rehab. Nicky took him 8th overall and didn't blink.

quickHits.label: Police blotter
quickHits.text: Josh Jacobs got charged in Wisconsin last Thursday over a domestic incident from May and fell all the way to round 11. Deanus grabbed him immediately. The Tweakers' draft board is just a court docket.

quickHits.label: Two kickers
quickHits.text: Nokia drafted two kickers back to back in rounds 14 and 15. The second one is on his bench. There is no universe where a bench kicker plays and he did it anyway.

quickHits.label: Mr. Irrelevant
quickHits.text: Pick 160, the very last pick of the entire draft, was Chris Boswell to Tony. 16 rounds and Tony's kicker was the caboose.

quickHits.label: Daniel Jones
quickHits.text: Big Sham took Daniel Jones in round 14 as his THIRD quarterback. Daniel Jones. In the year 2026. Big Sham owns Josh Allen and still felt like he needed Daniel Jones in his life.

quickHits.label: Drafted an injury
quickHits.text: REEEEECE saw the word OUT in red next to Charbonnet and drafted him anyway, straight onto IR. Bro is collecting them.

quickHits.label: QB panic
quickHits.text: Allen, Lamar, Daniels went 4, 5, 6. Three grown men panic-drafted quarterbacks in a row while Justin Jefferson sat there until pick 16 like a guy who showed up to the party on time.

quickHits.label: Dean's homework
quickHits.text: Dean of the Year and Dean of the Week are both TBD because Dean has to pick them and Dean has not picked them.

rankings.thoughts: Deanus. Took JT and Saquon back to back and then didn't draft a quarterback until round 8 in a league where QBs score 400 points. His QB1 is Kyler Murray, who is 5'9 and scored 90 points last year, most of them from the couch. His QB2 is Sam Darnold, who sees ghosts. His steal of the draft is Josh Jacobs, who fell to round 11 because he got charged in Wisconsin five days ago. Dean's draft strategy was 'is he in legal trouble? click.' Went 3-11 two years ago and named the team Dont truzz u, the most honest thing anyone in this league has ever done.

Big Sham scored 1,456 points last year, which is the fewest in league history and also roughly what Josh Allen scores by himself. So he took Josh Allen at 4 and then drafted running backs until the app asked if he was ok. Then three rookie wide receivers, then Daniel Jones as a backup plan, which is like buying a fire extinguisher that is also on fire. Username ravens69420. Zero Lamar. One Derrick Henry. Big year for the bit. Can you fade yourself?

EN. 10-4 two years in a row and has the exact same number of rings as the guys who went 5-9. Made SEVEN waiver moves all of last year, which is fewer times than Tony checks the app before breakfast. Chase, Maye, Hurts to start is nasty. Then the running backs are Kyren Williams and David Montgomery, two guys who will be 'day to day' by Halloween. Travis Hunter in round 10, a wide receiver who is also a cornerback who is also projected for 102 points. Logo is a SpongeBob stink gif. At least he's self aware.

J Will. 5-9 and 5-9. The Magic 8 Ball logo has been shaking its head for two years. Draft was honestly good, Daniels, CeeDee, Bowers, Dart in the 9th, and then he took Jeremiyah Love at 26 overall, a rookie who has never touched an NFL football and is already listed questionable, which is impressive for a guy who hasn't played. RB2 is Skattebo, who runs like he owes somebody money. Also took Christian Watson three picks after the league reset the draft because Nick took Christian Watson by accident. Read that again. Also drafted Jaylen Waddle. Seeberger, close your eyes.

Tony. 1.01 Gibbs, fine. Then Burrow at 20, coming off a year where he played about six games and spent the rest in a walking boot. Rhamondre Stevenson is his RB2, and he knows, and he's dropping him by week 3 anyway because he makes more waiver moves than the other nine of you combined. 9-5 last year, 3 seed, one and done. Also got stuck with the last pick of the entire draft, Chris Boswell, pick 160, the caboose. Ranked himself 6th so it looks fair. It is not fair.

meme.top: BURROW OFF AN INJURY. RHAMONDRE RB2. WRITES THE RANKINGS.
meme.caption: self roast so nobody else has to

rankings.thoughts: REEEEECE. Lamar at 5, fine, respect it. JJ, Breece, K9, TMac, the ceiling is real. The floor is that 5 of his guys are questionable and Charbonnet was already OUT when he drafted him. He saw the red letters and clicked anyway and put him straight on IR like he's collecting them. QB3 is Malik Willis, which is either a galaxy brain move or a Dolphins fan thing. 7th then 5th. Aggressively mid. Team is still called Your meat too much and the logo is still a personal photo nobody has asked about.

meme.top: DRAFT ONE HEALTHY GUY OR DRAW 25
meme.caption: round 12, Charbonnet, listed OUT

rankings.thoughts: D. REIGNING CHAMP. Most points in the league, 31 waiver moves, actually earned it, which is the most annoying possible way to win. Drafted Goff and Mahomes back to back at 50 and 51 like he was buying two of something at Costco, then C.J. Stroud in round 15 as a spare. JSN, Cook, Jeanty, Nico is filthy. TE is Tucker Kraft on one ACL. Champ at #4. Cry about it. Still soppin.

Nfatboy. Won it in 2024, then made THREE waiver moves in 2025, went 6-8, and two of the three were probably accidents. Speaking of accidents, he drafted Christian Watson by mistake and the entire league had to stop, pause and reset the draft so he could take DK Metcalf, which is the most Nick thing that has ever happened. Draft is nasty tho: Bijan, Hampton, Rice, Nabers, G Wilson, Nix, Baker. Also took Kelce in round 12 for the memories and grabbed the first kicker because he's a man of principle. If he opens the app this year he's the favorite. He will not open the app.

Seeberger. Team is named She's Jay-len on my Waddle. Jaylen Waddle plays for J Will. He did not draft him. He named his team after one guy and then didn't draft the guy. Also nobody, including Ryan, knows why Jay-len has a hyphen in the middle. It's been asked. There is no answer. What he does own: CMC, who is 30 and made of glass, ARSB, Olave, DeVonta, Stafford who is 38 and threw for 460 points last year out of spite, and Herbert. Best lineup in the league on paper. Paper is also what his 2024 1 seed was made of, because he went from the 1 seed to dead last in one calendar year, which should be studied by scientists.

meme.top: I NAMED MY TEAM AFTER JAYLEN WADDLE
meme.caption: he did not. also, the hyphen.

rankings.thoughts: Nokia Wolson. Went 7-7 last year with FIVE waiver moves and still made the playoffs, which is the fantasy football version of passing a class you never went to. Then he drafted the best team in the league by accident: Puka, Achane, TLaw, McBride, Caleb. Puka spent the offseason getting sued for allegedly biting a woman on the shoulder and then went to rehab, so the WR1 situation has a check engine light on. Also drafted two kickers back to back and 6 of his guys are questionable. #1 on paper. He'll make 4 moves all year and either prove Tony right or very, very wrong.

meme.top: I RECEIVE: 2 KICKERS + A GUY WHO BITES
meme.caption: Nicky's draft, as a trade offer

outro: Week 1 rankings drop Tuesday morning. Send memes.
